mitigation_descriptions: Follow best practices in restricting access to escalated privileges to avoid hostile programs from accessing sensitive regions of memory or credentials.

Take measures to detect or prevent techniques such as OS Credential Dumping. Limit credential overlap across systems to prevent access if account credentials are obtained. Audit domain and local accounts as well as their permission levels routinely to look for situations that could allow an adversary to gain wide access by obtaining credentials of a privileged account.
reasoning: The adversary activity was confirmed with high fidelity, demonstrating unauthorized access to /etc/shadow via sudo /bin/cat by account jward on intranet-server (T1003.008).
remediation_plan: 1. Isolate the affected host intranet-server (192.168.131.215) from the network to prevent lateral movement. 2. Terminate active sessions and revoke elevated sudo privileges for user account jward. 3. Rotate credentials, passwords, and SSH keys for all accounts present in /etc/shadow on the affected server. 4. Audit sudoers policies and local permission levels on intranet-server to enforce least privilege access. 5. Review authentication logs across the environment to identify any lateral movement using compromised credentials.
